license.attribution: Contains McLean County, Illinois address data from the county's public 'Addresses' ArcGIS item (502eefa828f94f749bbab9da63b0d016), licensed CC BY 4.0. Trail Mapper reduced it to address text, postal community, postal code and point, normalized the text, rounded points to 1e-6 degrees and removed non-McLean and unnumbered rows. This is not the county's own product and is not endorsed by the county.
license.changesMade: reduced fields; address text upper-cased with punctuation removed and directional and street-type words made canonical; points rounded to 1e-6 degrees; rows outside McLean County, without a leading house number, without a point, or exact duplicates removed (counts below)

transform.deterministic: verified at build time: the same rows in reverse order give the identical index bytes
